title:
Comment of kathie kingett in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 10/28/2026

documents.name: 151889.txt
documents.text:
kathie kingett, La Habra Hts, CA.
I am strongly opposed to any underwater data center construction.  We have enough problems with all the proposed data centers on land while, at the same time, we do not know enough about the sea bottom to protect it.  

We are well aware that Beluga Whales are endangered.  So we combine the problems with underwater data centers with the proposed placement of one in their habitat?

This makes no sense at all.  Please stop.
